purpose: Offline candidate for subsequent predict-only integration; no deployment configuration modified.
remaining_checks: Live camera/normalization/driver mapping in predict-only mode.
Gripper behavior, held targets and individual-episode regressions.
Complete observation-to-action delay and control interval; inference plus execution in series still causes delays.
Independent controlled robot trials and grasp/place success rates.

initial_attempt.cause: Overly strict cross-process per-coordinate allclose; observed maximum difference 0.005676 motor degrees. Strict attempt was preserved. Current run checks both motor/normalized coordinate differences and aggregate MSE consistency.

limitations: Only four validation episodes, also used for checkpoint selection; no independent test success rate.
Single-observation latency excludes live camera, preprocessing and robot I/O.
An action chunk of 0.8 seconds is an overlap budget, not an end-to-end closed-loop guarantee.
Closeness in offline command error does not establish safe or successful robot behavior.
No training, hardware connection, robot motion or persistent inference configuration change.
